description: This file contains visualization tools for operation stacks and graphs as DAGs, including functions to generate DOT format, visualize with Graphviz, and convert to NetworkX for plotting. It references external modules 'torchfuzz.ops_fuzzer' and 'torchfuzz.tensor_fuzzer'.

methods.name: save_and_render_dot
methods.description: Saves DOT content to a file and renders it as PNG using Graphviz.

methods.name: operation_graph_to_dot
methods.description: Converts an OperationGraph object into a Graphviz DOT format string for visualization.

methods.name: visualize_operation_graph
methods.description: Generates and saves a visualization of an OperationGraph to a specified folder.

methods.name: operation_graph_to_networkx
methods.description: Converts an OperationGraph into a NetworkX graph for visualization with matplotlib.
